nodes.text: Open your own Pandaria Engineering recipes and select Jard’s Peculiar Energy Source.

recovery.text: If the recipe is missing, switch expansion tiers and clear recipe filters. Skill level alone does not prove the recipe is learned.

recoveryCases.text: If the recipe is missing, switch expansion tiers and clear recipe filters. Skill level alone does not prove the recipe is learned.
Open your own Pandaria Engineering recipes and select Jard’s Peculiar Energy Source.

nodes.text: Craft Jard’s Peculiar Energy Source when its observed cooldown is ready. Gather the listed materials and tools first; use the in-game Craft button yourself.
nodes.details:
Open your own Pandaria Engineering recipes.
Craft Jard’s Peculiar Energy Source when available. Materials: 10 Ghost Iron Bars. Tools: Arclight Spanner.
